limitations: A proxy observation shows the request reached the monitored boundary, not that the remote application processed it.
A BLOCK MATCH (SCOPED_PROXY_ABSENCE) is scoped to this proxy and window; it does not prove host-wide absence.
Unequal body commitments show the canonical bodies differ; they do not identify which value changed or prove that a secret leaked.
Windows-local services share one account, so ledger and egress separation is not OS-enforced there. D5 validated the Docker role topology only.
All results come from a controlled laboratory with synthetic protected values; they are not real-world detection rates.
